claim: Open-source e-commerce application written in PHP, supporting major payment services, localised for many countries
Repository intended for development and preview only; stable version 9.0 downloaded from releases
PrestaShop 9.0 needs PHP 8.1+ and MySQL 5.6+; Apache or Nginx recommended
Core licensed under OSL-3.0, modules under AFL-3.0
Docker environment is for development with default admin credentials
Updating guide note: switching to the newest version is not trivial
Extensible through modules and themes; developers can override components
